use_case_summary: Customer building a searchable knowledge base for small law firms and in-house legal teams. Primary flow: user asks question -> embeddings-based retrieval -> lightweight reranker to surface exact clause snippets. Need short answers with provenance links. High emphasis on accuracy and traceability (cite clause and doc).
technical_requirements: Embeddings: must support Open-source embeddings or hosted embedding endpoint; evaluation on legal text (contracts, memos)
Reranking: separate lightweight reranker model to increase precision on top-k results
Vector DB: leaning toward managed vector DB; wants recommended pattern for indexing + metadata (doc id, clause offsets)
Latency target: p95 <= 300ms for single doc-search query (small doc sets, typical top-k=10)
Throughput: initial 50 qps burst capacity, steady-state ~5 qps
Cost sensitivity: high — wants guidance on token and embedding cost tradeoffs
Security: SSO/SAML for internal dashboard, audit logs for query events, retention controls (delete on request)
